data.long_meaning: Maviel is derived from the Hebrew word 'mah-vay-el', meaning 'Who is like God?' or 'God is my help'. In the Bible, this name is given to a Levite who worked at the Temple. The name Maviel carries the meaning “God is my help” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Maviel usually hope their child will grow to embody god is my help and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.name: Μαβιέλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο όρος Μαβιέλ είναι σύνθεση των λέξεων 'δώρο' και 'Θεός', δηλώνοντας το δωρό του Θεού ή προορισμένο για τον Θεό. Αντικατοπτρίζει την Ορθόδοξη άποψη περί της χάριτος και του έλεος του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Maviel
